notes.title: Raia Nova - The Illusion Update
notes.notes:
We are back. This update adds missions, rewards, skills, items, enemies, and cosmetics.
Aside from the changes below, throughout the game stats, rewards, bosses, and abilities were balanced and adjusted. There are too many small improvements to list.

This is called the Illusion update because of the illusion cosmetic items. But there are a lot of things in this update. [b]New Missions[/b] with new enemies. In "The Sage's Domain" there are are 2 new missions, Reverse Chasm and Mystery Jungle. They are difficult and grant an achievement. 
[b]Cobalt Hook[/b] - Gives you an attack that can pull you to enemies.
[b]Nether Font Belt[/b] - Makes Healing Font cause Nether Font.
[b]Tempest Belt[/b] - Changes the Tempest Ball skill.
A new reward can be earned in the Endgame, Illusion capsules. 
They can let you make your character into Wolf, Poison Imp, Grace, or Dhalia. This includes voice and some animations.
To use one, follow this example for Wolf.
Get "Design of Wolf" from an achievement. Get an [b]Illusion Capsule[/b] from an achievement or buying one from Vita. Combine them in the Mod Machine. Open the cosmetic panel and right click the new cosmetic. The Mod Machine and Cosmetic areas are accessed by going to a Hub and pressing G.

Evalor's voice and animation was improved/redone.
Blitz's Ultra range increased, Mothball Shell takes reduced damage from Earth to compensate.
Storm Axe buffed a little.
Blackpool and Radiate damage reduced.
Tempest Ball made more useful, reworked, new synergy with Tempest Belt.
Onyx Skin damage increased.
Bugs involving ladders and mounts fixed.
More "Yellows" (items with Rarity 2 found more often).
Needletail and some similar skills have a bigger projectile now.
Move input for Warp to Base and Mounts now cancels them on Gamepads.
Shattered Dreams was adjusted and now causes an effect on the Swing skill.
In "Data" the "failed" stat is fixed to work as desired, only a few levels can trigger it though.
Fixed some bosses randomly standing still.
Improved the projectile patterns for Dhalia and Grace's Ultra attacks.
Any enemy who shoots "Iceball" casts it slower now. It was too undodgable.
Shell skills would sometimes get stronger when used more, this is fixed.
Fate Tether now works with Pyrotech Torch and some other Ring skills. Sound fixed.
Fixed mouse size issues when game initializes
Arches (the endgame gates) show when a mission is complete.

I'm really happy with how this game and this update turned out. I am definitely still wanting to hear user feedback, comments and questions are welcome. You can use the website for contact options: [url=https://raianova.net/]raianova.net[/url]

notes.title: An update on the Release Date and Progress
notes.notes:
Raia Nova has come a long way and the decision has been made to push back the release date to February 18th 2025. We are working on end game challenges and some changes to Rune Trees and Skills that require extra time. The game will release with crafting and end game items that were never in any version before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594936/ba57c532e08e354077042d3b0b305f112b9547a5.png[/img]


Raia Nova features classic ARPG gameplay with equipable spells and difficult bosses. Enhancers exist to power up your favorite skills and the rune tree is there to progress and customize your character. There are 5 playable characters; Krin the Spellsword, Mothball the Magician, Basa the Gladiator, Dias the Thief, and Dweller the Warden. This is a single palyer game, the game's platform is Windows, on Steam.

notes.title: Release date: January 9th, 2025, it's now official
notes.notes:
Raia Nova is now planned for release on Jan 9! This game has been a long time in the making and has had it's release delayed before. We're almost done though, so get ready for the 1.0 release. Coming up, we will have changes that are not yet in the demo and test versions, including crafting, high level items, a better tutorial, and the unreleased portion of the campaign. Expect at least 1 Demo update before launch.
We know we can make this game great, so please send us your feedback and opinions.

About Raia Nova
Raia Nova features classic ARPG gameplay with collectable spells and difficult bosses. Skill enhancers exist to power up your favorite skills and the rune tree is there to progress and customize your character. There are 5 playable characters; Krin the Spellsword, Mothball the Magician, Basa the Gladiator, Dias the Thief, and Dweller the Warden. Each character has an Ultra skill that has a big effect on their gameplay, as well as having specific startup skill combos. You can also choose your own utility skills for different ways to dash, heal, and buff yourself.
Missions often feature unique mechanics, your goals and challenges will vary, and you will have to use everything at your disposal to make it through. Hordes of monsters, weird bosses, and complex character builds await in this upcoming ARPG.

notes.title: The Rise of... (Steam Next Fest and update)
notes.notes:
Raia Nova has recently gotten another big update, applying to both the demo and Beta versions. Most of the update is just fleshing out what was needed for many aspects of the game, so you may not notice right away. More skills were added and many tweaked and improved. Many bosses were improved and some things like animations and icons further built upon. The Story aspect has a bit more to it.
